description: Cell-specific CSCN graph inference on the network panel (config/cscn_panel.json), NTC cells only. The window is fixed a priori (0.35, from the earlier gene-CKM work); panel size, ci_alpha and max_conditioning were chosen from timing and graph diagnostics only, never from prediction performance (see selection).

selection.basis: graph diagnostics and runtime only (target connectivity, edges per cell, runtime); never prediction performance
selection.rationale: Window kept at the a priori 0.35: window changes (0.5, 0.65) gave no consistent benefit, and 0.65 disconnected the most-detected targets. ci_alpha 0.10 roughly doubles edges per cell (median 42 -> 78) and raises target connectivity (mean share of target nodes with >= 1 edge 0.18 -> 0.29), while edges stay far below the number expected if the local CI test were calibrated, i.e. the test is conservative on zero-inflated counts. max_conditioning 2-4 changed runtime and edges by < 3% (sparse skeletons); 4 is used.
selection.timing_grid: results/summary/cscn_panel_timing.csv (P x max_conditioning at window 0.35, ci_alpha 0.05)
selection.focal_cells: the same 20 seeded NTC cells per condition in every configuration
